import zipfile, shutil, os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', MAIN)

src = "sales_data.xlsx"
tmp = "sales_data_edit.xlsx"

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(src)
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)

sheet_xml = zin.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)

def q(tag):
    return f"{{{MAIN}}}{tag}"

# 1. Update dimension
dim = root.find(q("dimension"))
dim.set("ref", "A1:H10")

# 2. Add column 8 definition
cols = root.find(q("cols"))
col8 = ET.SubElement(cols, q("col"))
col8.set("width", "14")
col8.set("customWidth", "1")
col8.set("min", "8")
col8.set("max", "8")

# 3. Add cells to rows
sheetData = root.find(q("sheetData"))
for row in sheetData.findall(q("row")):
    rn = int(row.get("r"))
    if rn == 1:
        c = ET.SubElement(row, q("c"))
        c.set("r", "H1")
        c.set("s", "1")
        c.set("t", "inlineStr")
        is_ = ET.SubElement(c, q("is"))
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, q("t"))
        t.text = "Profit Margin %"
    else:
        c = ET.SubElement(row, q("c"))
        c.set("r", f"H{rn}")
        c.set("s", "3")
        f = ET.SubElement(c, q("f"))
        f.text = f"G{rn}/E{rn}"
        v = ET.SubElement(c, q("v"))

new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)

# 4. Add percent number format style (numFmtId 10 = 0.00%)
styles_xml = zin.read("xl/styles.xml").decode("utf-8")
sroot = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
cellXfs = sroot.find(q("cellXfs"))
cellXfs.set("count", str(len(cellXfs.findall(q("xf"))) + 1))
xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, q("xf"))
xf.set("numFmtId", "10")
xf.set("fontId", "0")
xf.set("fillId", "0")
xf.set("borderId", "0")
xf.set("pivotButton", "0")
xf.set("quotePrefix", "0")
xf.set("xfId", "0")
xf.set("applyNumberFormat", "1")
new_styles_xml = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)

for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
        data = new_sheet_xml.encode("utf-8")
    elif item.filename == "xl/styles.xml":
        data = new_styles_xml.encode("utf-8")
    zout.writestr(item, data)

zout.close()
zin.close()

os.replace(tmp, src)
print("done")

from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def q(t):
    return f"{{{MAIN}}}{t}"

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')

print(z.namelist())

# Locate worksheet file(s) via workbook rels
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
sheet_files = []
for sheet in wb.findall(q('sheets') + '/' + q('sheet')):
    rid = sheet.get(f'{{{R}}}id')
    for rel in rels.findall(f'{{{R}}}Relationship'):
        if rel.get('Id') == rid and 'worksheet' in rel.get('Type', ''):
            sheet_files.append(rel.get('Target'))

print("worksheet files:", sheet_files)

errors = []
for sf in sheet_files:
    target = 'xl/' + sf if not sf.startswith('/') else sf.lstrip('/')
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
    print(f"\n== {target}: dimension =", root.find(q('dimension')).get('ref'))
    for row in root.findall(q('sheetData') + '/' + q('row')):
        rn = row.get('r')
        cells = {}
        for c in row.findall(q('c')):
            ref = c.get('r')
            f = c.find(q('f'))
            v = c.find(q('v'))
            formula = f.text if f is not None else None
            value = v.text if v is not None else None
            cells[ref] = (formula, value)
            if value and str(value).startswith('#'):
                errors.append((target, ref, value))
        print("row", rn, cells)

print("\nerror cells:", errors)

import zipfile, os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def q(t):
    return f"{{{MAIN}}}{t}"

src = 'sales_data.xlsx'
tmp = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(src)

sheet_xml = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)

cells = {}
for row in root.findall(q('sheetData') + '/' + q('row')):
    rn = int(row.get('r'))
    for c in row.findall(q('c')):
        ref = c.get('r')
        f = c.find(q('f'))
        v = c.find(q('v'))
        cells[ref] = {'f': f.text if f is not None else None,
                      'v': v.text if v is not None else None}

def num(ref):
    return float(cells[ref]['v'])

computed = {}
# Data rows 2..9
for r in range(2, 10):
    e = num(f'C{r}') * num(f'D{r}')
    g = e - num(f'C{r}') * num(f'F{r}')
    h = g / e
    computed[f'E{r}'] = e
    computed[f'G{r}'] = g
    computed[f'H{r}'] = h
# Totals row 10
e10 = sum(computed[f'E{r}'] for r in range(2, 10))
g10 = sum(computed[f'G{r}'] for r in range(2, 10))
computed['E10'] = e10
computed['G10'] = g10
computed['H10'] = g10 / e10

# Write cached values into existing <v> elements (formulas preserved)
for row in root.findall(q('sheetData') + '/' + q('row')):
    for c in row.findall(q('c')):
        ref = c.get('r')
        v = c.find(q('v'))
        if ref in computed and v is not None:
            val = computed[ref]
            v.text = ('%d' % val) if float(val).is_integer() else repr(val)

# Confirm H1 header inline string
h1 = None
for row in root.findall(q('sheetData') + '/' + q('row')):
    if row.get('r') == '1':
        for c in row.findall(q('c')):
            if c.get('r') == 'H1':
                t = c.find(q('is') + '/' + q('t'))
                h1 = t.text if t is not None else None
print('H1 header:', h1)
print('computed:', computed)

new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode', xml_declaration=True)

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = new_sheet_xml.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()
os.replace(tmp, src)
print('done')

def q(tag):
    return f"{{{MAIN}}}{tag}"

# 1. Update dimension
dim = root.find(q("dimension"))
dim.set("ref", "A1:H10")

# 2. Add column 8 definition
cols = root.find(q("cols"))
col8 = ET.SubElement(cols, q("col"))
col8.set("width", "14")
col8.set("customWidth", "1")
col8.set("min", "8")
col8.set("max", "8")

# 3. Add cells to rows
sheetData = root.find(q("sheetData"))
for row in sheetData.findall(q("row")):
    rn = int(row.get("r"))
    if rn == 1:
        c = ET.SubElement(row, q("c"))
        c.set("r", "H1")
        c.set("s", "1")
        c.set("t", "inlineStr")
        is_ = ET.SubElement(c, q("is"))
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, q("t"))
        t.text = "Profit Margin %"
    else:
        c = ET.SubElement(row, q("c"))
        c.set("r", f"H{rn}")
        c.set("s", "3")
        f = ET.SubElement(c, q("f"))
        f.text = f"G{rn}/E{rn}"
        v = ET.SubElement(c, q("v"))

new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)

# 4. Add percent number format style (numFmtId 10 = 0.00%)
styles_xml = zin.read("xl/styles.xml").decode("utf-8")
sroot = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
cellXfs = sroot.find(q("cellXfs"))
cellXfs.set("count", str(len(cellXfs.findall(q("xf"))) + 1))
xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, q("xf"))
xf.set("numFmtId", "10")
xf.set("fontId", "0")
xf.set("fillId", "0")
xf.set("borderId", "0")
xf.set("pivotButton", "0")
xf.set("quotePrefix", "0")
xf.set("xfId", "0")
xf.set("applyNumberFormat", "1")
new_styles_xml = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)

for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
        data = new_sheet_xml.encode("utf-8")
    elif item.filename == "xl/styles.xml":
        data = new_styles_xml.encode("utf-8")
    zout.writestr(item, data)

zout.close()
zin.close()

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def q(t):
    return f"{{{MAIN}}}{t}"

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

def cell_text(c):
    t = c.get('t')
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        el = c.find(q('is') + '/' + q('t'))
        return el.text if el is not None else None
    if t == 's':
        v = c.find(q('v'))
        return f"<shared:{v.text}>" if v is not None else None
    v = c.find(q('v'))
    return v.text if v is not None else None

for row in root.findall(q('sheetData') + '/' + q('row')):
    rn = row.get('r')
    out = []
    for c in row.findall(q('c')):
        ref = c.get('r')
        f = c.find(q('f'))
        txt = cell_text(c)
        if ref[0] in 'ABCDEFGH':
            out.append(f"{ref}: t={c.get('t')} f={f.text if f is not None else None!r} val={txt!r}")
    print("row", rn, "|", " | ".join(out))

# Shared strings table for reference
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    texts = []
    for si in sst.findall(q('si')):
        ts = si.findall(q('t'))
        texts.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in ts))
    print("\nsharedStrings:", texts)
